COLOSSAL_FLOWER.pages.DEHYA_THROW_PROBE_:
You grab something from your belt and hurl it at the razor-sharp bloom.

Its keen petals shred the bottle in an instant.

Plainly this thing preys on anything that dares come near — better keep your distance.

You grab something from your belt and hurl it at the razor-sharp bloom.

Its keen petals shred the bottle in an instant, and the scattering shards seem to rouse something.

Plainly this thing preys on anything that dares come near — better keep your distance.
COLOSSAL_FLOWER.pages.INITIAL.options.DE: Lose a random [gold]potion[/gold]. Upgrade cards in your deck (1 for a Common potion, 2 for Uncommon or Rare).
SPIRIT_GRAFTER.pages.DEHYA_SHATTER.descr:
With one punch you tear the unbidden soul in two. Its burning light flickers twice in the air, then dies out into the night.

Your fists feel steadier than before. Yet something seems forgotten...

You press onward.
SPIRIT_GRAFTER.pages.INITIAL.options.DEH: Downgrade 2 random cards. Remove 1 random card.
STS2_DEHYA_EVENT_DANGEROUS_COMPANION.pag:
Pierced by your accusation, he flushes with shame and flees.

Another lesson learned — in the Spire, trust no one so readily.

You wonder what he is really up to, so you play along, watching his every move.

Sure enough, once you reach a deserted stretch, he draws his dagger, bares his fangs, and demands your coin.

What a "clever" plan — pity he chose the wrong prey this time.

You take a few scrapes beating him down, but he will remember the lesson.

A warrior with a curved blade at his waist blocks your path. "Hey, friend — you are a mercenary too, aren't you? Why don't we travel together?"

Warm as his words are, you spot at a glance the sharp dagger hidden behind his back.

You decide...
Upgrade 2 random cards in your deck.
Lose {HpLoss} HP. Remove a card from your deck.
STS2_DEHYA_EVENT_SCORCHING_FLARE.pages.E:
You drive the flame with the power of your Vision. It shrinks, curls into your palm, and melts into your gauntlets.

You feel your vigor returning.

Without hesitation you unstopper your canteen and pour it over the blinding blaze. The flames gutter out at once, leaving a small hard mass gleaming in the ashes.

You pick up the charred husk and press on.
STS2_DEHYA_EVENT_SCORCHING_FLARE.pages.I:
A raging blaze comes rushing toward you. Its glare forces your eyes shut.

You decide...
Lose a random [gold]potion[/gold]. Gain a Common [gold]relic[/gold].
STS2_DEHYA_EVENT_SCORCHING_FLARE.title: Scorching Flare
STS2_DEHYA_EVENT_TRANSPORT_COMMISSION.pa:
You hoist the crate with ease and carry it along the route the goblins indicate.

They seem delighted, fishing a few coins from their belts and pressing them into your hand.

You pocket the gold and press on.

A cluster of short goblins stands before you, seemingly troubled by a massive wooden crate they cannot carry away.

They wave you over, signaling that they will pay you to help transport it.

You decide...

Curiosity gets the better of you — what is inside that crate? You fight the goblins and finally wrestle it into your possession.

Inside sits a small pouch containing exactly what you needed.

You strap the pouch to your belt and stride onward.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.DEHYA_TOSS.description:
You decide not to be distracted by scrap and rubbish. Better to discard some useless baggage here and travel lighter.

You take stock of your supplies, abandon some cumbersome gear, and continue your journey.
